sources.title: Hyena · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Hyena is a new type of operator that serves as a substitute for the attention mechanism. Developed by Hazy Research, it features a subquadratic computational efficiency, constructed by interleaving implicitly parametrized long convolutions and data-controlled gating.
